detailed_descriptions.en: You're a spirited young man, ready to make the most of a new start! Meet the colorful cast of townsfolk and live your life to the fullest while making friends with all of the people around you! Choose what adventures you’ll go on each day as you maneuver around town in this non-linear open-ended game! Discover fun mini games and special seasonal events as you choose the right options to grow close to each of the girls. A colorful cast to interact with! Explore the town and meet all the quirky, unique girls. Get to know them and make some close friends along the way! Follow the calendar Keep an eye on the clock! Where you'll find certain characters and the places you can visit will change depending on the day of the week and time of day. There's also seasonal events that you won't wanna miss!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You're a spirited young man, ready to make the most of a new start! Meet the colorful cast of townsfolk and live your life to the fullest while making friends with all of the people around you!

Choose what adventures you’ll go on each day as you maneuver around town in this non-linear open-ended game! Discover fun mini games and special seasonal events as you choose the right options to grow close to each of the girls.

A colorful cast to interact with!

Explore the town and meet all the quirky, unique girls. Get to know them and make some close friends along the way!

Follow the calendar

Keep an eye on the clock! Where you'll find certain characters and the places you can visit will change depending on the day of the week and time of day. There's also seasonal events that you won't wanna miss!
